title: Closed-support finite-constant tensor bound
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $N$ a finite $A$-module. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion and $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ its quasi-compact complementary open immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Use the ordinary derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], its ambient closed right adjoint $Ri^!$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For a scheme $S$, let $N_S$ denote the constant module sheaf associated to $N$, placed in degree zero [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $a,b,c\in\mathbf Z$ with $c\geq0$. Assume $\mathcal H^q(Rj_*M)=0$ for every $A$-module sheaf $M$ on $U$ and every $q>c$. If $K$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude], then $\mathcal H^q(Ri^!K\otimes_A^L N_Z)=0$ for $q<a$ or $q>b+c+1$. No constructibility hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Rewrite the integer cohomological-dimension bound as vanishing of right-derived functors in natural degrees above c.toNat. The open immersion is quasi-separated. By lem-exc-direct-image-coproducts, Rj_* preserves countable coproducts. Apply lem-exc-constant-tensor to the given finite module N to obtain the invertible projection map.

source.place: Proof, constant derived tensor and support-triangle paragraphs (steps 5–6 of prop-exc-closed-tor)

proof.text: Put V=N_T[0] and H=K tensor V. Tensor the distinguished support triangle of K with V. Compose the open projection isomorphism with the inverse-image tensor isomorphism and the canonical identification of derived and termwise exact inverse images; this identifies the third term with Rj_*j^*H. The projection-map unit identity, followed by cancellation of the inverse-image comparison, identifies the middle arrow with the unit of H. TR3 extends the identity on H and this third-term isomorphism to a morphism of distinguished triangles. The two-isomorphisms lemma makes its first component invertible. No functorial cone is chosen.

source.place: Proof, constant derived tensor and support-triangle paragraphs (steps 5–6 of prop-exc-closed-tor)

proof.text: Apply Li^* to the first-term isomorphism. Monoidality and the fully faithful closed direct-image counit Li^*Ri_* isomorphic to Id identify its source with Ri^!K tensor Li^*V and its target with Ri^!H. The constant inverse-image isomorphism, transported through the degree-zero embedding, identifies Li^*V with N_Z[0]. Thus Ri^!K tensor N_Z is isomorphic to Ri^!H.

source.place: Proof, constant derived tensor and support-triangle paragraphs (steps 5–6 of prop-exc-closed-tor)

proof.text: Test the assumed Tor amplitude of K directly on the constant sheaf N_T, giving cohomology of H in [a,b]. Apply only the cohomology clause of lem-exc-closed-amplitude to H, obtaining cohomology of Ri^!H in [a,b+c+1]. Transport the vanishing along the isomorphism of the preceding step. The argument also applies when a>b and uses no constructibility of H.

theorem closedSupport_finiteTensor_vanishing
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) [Finite N]
    {Z T U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (_hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (a b c : ℤ) (_hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (_hcd : ∀ (M : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (q : ℤ), c < q →
      IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))))
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A T)
    (_hTor : DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn A T a b K) :
    ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b + c + 1 < q → IsZero
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).obj
          ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i)).rightAdjoint.obj K)).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj N))))
